subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the wanderer in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a woman in a long dark indigo coat with a hood, long wavy brown hair beneath it and a brown shoulder strap, carrying in her right hand a tall wooden staff with a hooked top from which a small brass lantern hangs, glowing gold. Her movements are slow and deliberate.
<Subject 2> is the rendering style of <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>: a hand-drawn night landscape built from thick rhythmic curved strokes and engraved contour lines, a swirling indigo and navy sky with spiraling clouds outlined in pale blue and gold, glowing star orbs ringed with halos, and golden wheat drawn stalk by stalk.
<Subject 3> is the falling star: one of the glowing star orbs of the sky, a bright gold-white point wrapped in spiral halo rings, seen at the upper left of <Picture 2>.

detailed_description:
The target video is a hand-drawn night landscape in motion in <Subject 2>: every stroke of the sky, clouds and wheat keeps its drawn texture as it moves, the clouds and star halos slowly swirling.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> walks away along the path toward the moon, the lantern swaying on its hook. High in the sky one of the star orbs begins to brighten and pulse, its halo rings widening. She slows, takes two more steps and stops, looking up. With her left hand she pushes her hood back, and her long wavy brown hair falls loose over her shoulders and lifts in the wind. <Subject 3> breaks loose from its place and begins to drift down through the swirling clouds in a slow spiral, pulling the curved strokes of the sky around it. She turns slightly to the right and raises the staff high with her right arm, lifting the glowing lantern toward the falling star. The camera sinks lower behind her and tilts up at slow speed in one continuous move, the moon sliding down into the frame and growing larger as the sky fills the upper part of the frame. The camera is still tilting as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.

overall_soundscape:
The wind hisses through the wheat and crickets chirp. Her footsteps slow and stop, and her hood rustles as it falls back. A faint crystalline hum rises from the sky as the star brightens and grows louder as it begins to fall.
